definitions.explanation: A plate of intermediate size, typically around 15-21 cm in diameter. Part of the standard Japanese tableware size system that distinguishes small, medium, and large plates.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{中皿|ちゅうざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}った→盛る：00292_moru⟧。
examples.english: I served the salad on a medium plate.

examples.japanese: {中皿|ちゅうざら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{取|と}り{分|わ}ける→取り分ける：22512_toriwakeru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中皿|ちゅうざら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Medium plates are convenient when serving portions.

notes:
{中皿|ちゅうざら} is a medium-sized plate, typically 15-21 cm in diameter. Part of the standard Japanese tableware size system.

SIZE SYSTEM:
- ⟦{小皿|こざら}→小皿：04476_kozara⟧: small plate (up to ~15 cm) — condiments, pickles
- {中皿|ちゅうざら}: medium plate (~15-21 cm) — individual portions
- ⟦{大皿|おおざら}→大皿：04477_oozara⟧: large plate (~22 cm+) — shared dishes

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中皿|ちゅうざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧: to serve on a medium plate
- {中皿|ちゅうざら}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: medium-plate dish
- ⟦{取|と}り{皿|ざら}→取り皿：17051_torizara⟧: serving plate (for taking portions from shared dishes)

USAGE:
In Japanese cuisine, plate size is carefully chosen to match the dish. {中皿|ちゅうざら} is the standard size for individual side dishes and salads.
